text_block_list.text:
One evening, while checking the track 
conditions――

A clanking metallic sound echoes through 
the air. Looking toward the noise, I see 
an Umamusume running.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Test measurement complete. Condition 
normal. Determined that load increase is 
feasible. Appropriate weight load is—

Looking at her feet after she finished 
running, I saw a large number of heavy, 
formidable weights strapped around them.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—These are custom-made ankle weights 
designed to increase the load during 
training.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No problem. Based on the previous 
measurement results, even attaching double 
this amount falls within standard 
tolerance.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I will proceed to re-evaluate the optimal 
workload. Excuse me.

...Even after that, Mihono Bourbon 
continued to increase the weight and ran 
without any issue whatsoever.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Situation assessed. Conducting this 
training at night poses a risk of negative 
neighborhood impact due to noise levels.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My apologies, the noise issue was an 
oversight. Thank you for bringing it to 
our attention.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Going forward, we will implement 
countermeasures such as adjusting the time 
slots to ensure it runs without issue.
